title: MiDM: Minimal Decision Models and an audit of CLM-8B
description:
MiDM v0.2.1 documentation and benchmark-analysis release. Model weights are unchanged from v0.2.0. Includes a 13-row benchmark atlas, architecture comparison, exact adapter/pointer parameter counts, and five reproducible parameter-performance/comparison figures in PNG and SVG with source hashes.

Matched 4B/9B results are separated from historical local controls and published or API/reasoning comparators. Public JevBench accuracy is not the official composite. MiDM DeepSWE and local Terminal-Bench remain unmeasured because matching raw verifier candidate pools were not found in the rechecked upstream artifacts. No scores are invented. SQL/Python regressions and routing limits are retained. No private financial data, raw benchmark examples, generated report text or credentials are included. Model adapters remain separately hosted on Hugging Face.
